statements.t: The Company is updating its 2026 outlook, which is subject to adjustments the Company may identify during its ongoing review:
“Our updated outlook reflects ongoing macroeconomic headwinds, continued pressure on lower-income consumers across Take 5, Maaco and Collision, and additional restatement-related costs,” said Rivera.
“Against this backdrop, we now expect Take 5 same store sales growth of 3.5% to 4.0% for the full year.”
The Company has significantly expanded the scope of its review and the resources dedicated to it and expects to incur additional restatement-related costs in 2027 as it completes this work.
Note: The Company’s 2026 outlook excludes the impact of any potential M&A and divestitures other than the completed divestiture of the international car wash business.
